pr_title: fix(click): wait for button, input and select to be enabled before clicking

issue_context.title: [BUG] Actionability: Playwright does not wait for button to be enabled
issue_context.body: Clicking `<button disabled>` or `<span>` inside `<button disabled>`is silently going through. Should be waiting for `disabled` to be dropped.

review_comments: Should we check for disabled before stability because it is cheaper?
I think we still have to save `lastRect`, so the difference would be negligible.
